scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with a large staircase leading up to a white building in the distance. The sky is partly cloudy and blue. There are two large stone pillars on either side of the stairs, each topped with a statue. People are milling about on the steps and in front of them. A woman walks towards the camera in the foreground wearing a dark blue jacket and jeans. The ground is paved and there are trees lining the sides of the stairs.}
